symptom: A duplicate ADHOC (ADHOC-prm-reqctl-status-20260816) was dispatched to mark PRM-02/03/04/05 RELEASED against a stale repo view; its pre-flight discovered the target status already RELEASED at HEAD and aborted BLOCKER. Separately, GH-797's body stated 'Tracked as ISS-0709', which pointed at the unrelated lint_handoffs/GH-796 issue instead of a dedicated ISS for GH-797.

root_cause: Dispatch-time staleness: an ADHOC was authorized against an outdated view of the repo; its pre-flight precondition caught the already-done state only after step-00 had already created the housekeeping branch and stash. No lightweight dispatch-time check (reqctl.py show <id> or git show HEAD:<file>) existed to short-circuit before work-branch creation. Bookkeeping: GH-797 was created with a 'Tracked as ISS-0709' line that referenced the wrong issue (ISS-0709 belongs to the unrelated lint_handoffs/GH-796 issue), and no dedicated ISS had been registered for GH-797.

Step 2 (CODE-DESIGNER) produced the design artefact src/design/iss0710-gh797-dispatch-staleness-gate.md; Step 3 (BACKEND-DEV) implemented it: new ORCH construction rule (§5 rule 7) + new pre-dispatch gate §8f 'Dispatch-Time Staleness Check' in docs/agents/ORCHESTRATOR.md, mirrored to the canonical .claude/agents/orchestrator.md and both GitHub-harness adapters (.github/instructions/orchestrator.instructions.md, .github/agents/orchestrator.agent.md) per AGENT_SYSTEM.md §9 (A007). actions: Dispatch-time staleness check before any ADHOC step-00: whenever an ADHOC's desired end state is a status change in a tracked YAML/data file (e.g. marking requirement IDs RELEASED), ORCH must run the §8f gate BEFORE dispatching step-00, short-circuiting with a BLOCKER if any target is already at the desired end state at origin/main HEAD.

Always `git fetch origin` before reading target status: read only the fetched origin/main ref (git show origin/main:<file>), never the working tree and never the local main branch; reqctl.py show <id> is valid only when the working tree is verified to be at origin/main HEAD.

Judge the gate by exit code only (§8a/§8e) and log every DISPATCH_STALE decision (CLEARED/BLOCKER) to handoffs/orchestrator.log; never phrase an ADHOC task as 'make X stop appearing' and never arrange for a failed read to pass (anti-patterns 2026-05-30 label-renaming incident).
